shadows.name: steam-glow
shadows.purpose: Interactive highlight for primary focus elements.

motion.name: snappy
motion.purpose: Quick, responsive transitions for the utility feel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #66c0f4; color: #1b2838; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7ed1ff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 192, 244, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Art Slot
components.css: .ds-art-slot { width: 160px; aspect-ratio: 2/3; background: #171a21; border: 1px solid #2a475e; border-radius: 4px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-art-slot:hover { border-color: #66c0f4; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-art-placeholder { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #8f98a0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; } .ds-art-label { position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.9)); padding: 8px 4px; color: white; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 900; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

narrative.overview: A utility that feels like an organic part of the Steam ecosystem, prioritizing functional density and tonal depth.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Steam Blue accent on ≤10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Surface Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth via tonal shifts, not structural shadows.

dos: Do use radial gradients for focus
Do use bold weight contrast for hierarchy
